statements.impact_statement: CPython 3.11.16 includes the 3.11 backport commit dae4b1a21f8df4570e30986affd61bbe4ade4cef, and the official 3.11.16 release record identifies gh-145599 as the fix for CVE-2026-3644.
CPython 3.11.16 includes the 3.11 backport commit 642865ddf4b232da1f3b1f7abcfa3254c4bfe785, and the official 3.11.16 release record identifies gh-145986 as the fix for CVE-2026-4224.

The signed CPython v3.11.16 tag is three commits after the merged 3.11 backport cbaecf9f16da611a646d507c1cbca265c588fc56 and also includes bundled Expat 2.8.3, which supplies the required XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes API.
